title: CWP/13826/2024 of GURBACHAN SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
Sr. No.101 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision : 21.02.2025 Gurbachan Singh …Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and others …Respondents CORAM : HON’BLE MS. JUSTICE LAPITA BANERJI Present : Mr. Kulwinder Singh, Advocate and Mr. Abhishek, Advocate for Mr. Rakesh Kumar, Advocate, for the petitioner. Mr. Aditya Sharda, DAG, Punjab. LAPITA BANERJI, J. (Oral) Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that license of the petitioner as a stamp vendor was not renewed illegally and arbitrarily by the State Authorities. Therefore, he filed the present writ petition praying for a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to renew his license that was granted to him on December 6, 2022 (Annexure P-1) by the District Collector, Ferozepur.

2. Issue notice to the respondents.

3. Learned State counsel accepts notice on behalf of the respondents and submits that the license was issued on December 6, 2022 till March 31, 2023. The petitioner functioned as a stamp vendor only for a period of two months. However, a fresh advertisement No.HRC/92 dated 15.02.2025 in the newspapers Punjab Kesari and Spokesman dated 18.02.2025 has been issued and the petitioner can apply under the said advertisement for grant of license under Punjab Stamp Rules, 1934.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the material on record.

5. In the event, the petitioner applies for license under the fresh advertisement dated 15.02.2025, his application shall be considered by the respondents in accordance with law and the terms of the advertisement.

6. With directions aforesaid, CWP-13826-2024 is disposed of.

7. Connected applications, if any, are accordingly disposed of. (LAPITA BANERJI) JUDGE February 21, 2025 Vandana
